plan.archetype: Multi-hit tempo with scalable damage and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Clear nine Slippery stacks with cheap multi-hits. Prepare upgraded Neutralize and strong block for Dismember, sustained damage, and defensive potions.
plan.summary: Add efficient damage first, then scaling and reliable block. Remove Strikes after replacements. Fight elites with sufficient HP and potions; avoid unsupported combos and arrive healthy at Vantom.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity defense and cheap Slippery removal
plan.bossPrep: Strip nine Slippery stacks with cheap attacks, sustain poison, maintain Weak, and reserve strong block or potions for Dismember. Enter healthy.
plan.summary: Prioritize defense and draw over more ordinary attacks. Upgrade Neutralize now, heal at the next fire, and reassess before the elite. Support existing poison with dexterity and acceleration; remove Strikes.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with discard-enabled setup and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish poison early, accelerate it behind Weak and dexterity block, and play Frantic Escape before the sand timer expires. Bring defensive potions.
plan.summary: Strengthen existing poison with defense and draw/discard; remove Strikes. Bank energy only when defense and Escape remain covered. Avoid elites, use Mailbox rests for recovery and potions, and upgrade Accelerant or Footwork when safe.
